label: Shure PA411 (Four Port Antenna Combiner, 470-865 Mhz)

_avail.description: Antenna Combiner for PSM 300 Wireless Systems
_avail.note: Power draw in W not published. Price list net weight 1.996 kg differs from datasheet weight (datasheet value used).
_avail.notes: Dimensions changed W 198 / D 177 mm -> W 177 / D 198 mm (spec sheet: 42 x 177 x 198 mm H x W x D) and weight 1.3 kg -> 1.62 kg per PA411 spec sheet p.1.; powerDrawW 13.4 W computed from the PA411 specification sheet (shure/pa411-specification-sheet-english.pdf; no input current published, DC outputs 12 V DC, 1.4 A max combined): 12 × 1.4 = 16.8 VA × 0.8 (AVAIL utilisation factor), as accepted by proposal 55e4edc6; mostly power passed to PSM300 (P3T) transmitters. Computed: V × A × 0.8
_avail.portsMissing: The PA411 spec sheet gives the panels only as drawings: DC input and DC output connector types and the number of RF output connectors (one main output assumed) are not stated in text.
